:::{#thm-deriv-polynomial}
#### Power rule

For every [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) $q$ and every $x > 0$
[@wikipedia_power_rule],
the [derivative](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-derivative) of the [power](algebra.qmd#def-real-power) $x^q$ is:

$$\deriv{x}x^q = qx^{q-1}$$

When $q$ is a [positive integer](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-positive-integer),
the same [formula](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/expressions-algorithms.html#def-closed-form-expression) holds for every [real](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) $x$.

:::
